# Retry one logical job through two actual Linux helper processes.
server start
retry-task task.json once 1
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id retry-success --wait
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED"'
job-id JOB
history failed succeeded
exists first second
skygo jobs logs $JOB --attempt 1
stdout '^attempt one\n$'
! stdout 'attempt two'
skygo jobs logs $JOB --attempt 2
stdout '^attempt two\n$'
! stdout 'attempt one'
skygo jobs logs $JOB
stdout '^attempt two\n$'
! skygo jobs logs $JOB --attempt 3
stderr 'attempt'
# Replaying the original request waits for the same completed job and creates
# neither another logical job nor another helper process.
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id retry-success --wait
stdout '"id": *"'$JOB'"'
history failed succeeded
calls SubmitRetryJob 2
calls SubmitJob 0
calls PlanTask 0
calls GetServerInfo 0
server stop
! stderr .
